svg.title: From a completely positive model to an internal matrix algebra
svg.desc: The return map is an isometric compression in a properly infinite algebra. Strong approximation of the isometry by unitaries gives an actual conjugate matrix algebra. A second construction in the relative commutant retains each previous factor exactly. Strong convergence does not include convergence of adjoints.

g.text: Finite maps become internal matrix algebras
M properly infinite · D = Mₘ ⊂ M · S and T unital completely positive
v* v = 1; z is a contraction
Strong tests on ξ, Uξ, U*ξ
A generating sequence needs exact containment
Separable predual: approximate the next coefficients in C = A′ ∩ M.
The upper route controls a finite set; the lower route organizes the approximations into a nested sequence.
Proofs: SMA-02, SMA-04–06. Source comparison: Takesaki III, XVI.1, Lemmas 1.1, 1.10 and Theorems 1.4, 1.9.
The single-compression step uses proper infiniteness; a finite matrix depolarizing map is a counterexample.
